## Adding a new agent backend?

If you want to add support for an agent (Gemini, aider, Cursor, …):

- Skim [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — the engine interface is
  three methods.
- File this issue with the CLI command + auth method, and we'll either
  help you write the PR or take it ourselves if it's small.
